quotes.text: In co-pilot studio, an autonomous agent isn't a polite chatbot that waits for instructions. It's a self-operating construct with three core components, a trigger, logic, and orchestration.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Defines an autonomous agent by its three building blocks.

quotes.text: In large language models, dropping multiple prompts at once invites contamination. One question's context may pollute the next answer. By isolating each prompt, we enforce mental hygiene.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why the agent answers one question per loop iteration.

quotes.text: A custom knowledge base narrows its range but increases precision and compliance. In regulated environments, reliability always outperforms creativity.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear recommendation for internal grounding over web grounding.

quotes.text: Generative AI's greatest gift is eloquence. Its greatest flaw is confidence. That's why human in the loop remains non-negotiable.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concise argument for human review of AI-generated answers.

quotes.text: So the reality check, autonomy doesn't absorb your responsibility. It transfers it. You've automated labor, not accountability. The spreadsheet now answers itself, yes, but you still own its truth, its traceability and its tone.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Frames governance as ownership that stays with the builder.

chapters.title: Input flow design in Power Automate

takeaways: An autonomous Copilot Studio agent combines a trigger, logic and orchestration, with Power Automate handling the email intake and reply while the agent fills the Excel table.
Processing one question per loop with the Create Generative Answers node and a named Excel table keeps answers deterministic and avoids context bleed.
Ground the agent in internal knowledge, keep a human in the loop for accuracy, and move to Dataverse or SharePoint lists once volumes grow.
hook: Answering request-for-information spreadsheets by copying and pasting is slow and error-prone. This episode walks Power Platform builders through an autonomous Copilot Studio agent that reads an emailed Excel RFI, answers every row with generative AI, writes the answers back and replies to the sender, and covers the governance needed to run it safely.
